value.title: Reviewer LOG single append needs no window

sections.name: body
sections.value: PM clarified the reviewer outputs/LOG.md protocol: use one small append, not read-modify-write; no baton or serialization window is needed. This supersedes the coordination difficulty in the Role lifecycle boundaries and scoped actions note. Check for an owner-written entry before adding another: the PR 135 e60be548 entry was already present once at LOG line 127, so no duplicate was appended. Keep verdict files separate and reply with the verdict and report pointer after the ledger entry exists.
